en: Black-and-white vintage waterfront scene showing a broad quay lined with elegant multi‑storey buildings and rows of masted sailing ships moored along the promenade. Smaller motorboats and wooden piers occupy the foreground, with calm water stretching toward the city skyline in the distance. Handwritten-style caption text in Swedish appears along the bottom edge, and a small publisher credit is printed in the lower left.
